titel: Click Cuts, galerijbeeld 'Three steps in one tab' op Superhive (echt Blender-paneel)
rol: You make or download 3D models and print them at home, but many models are bigger than your printer bed. You are browsing the Superhive (Blender Market) store for a Blender add-on that cuts a model into parts that fit your printer and go back together. You are not a Blender expert and want to know how easy the add-on is to use. You are now looking at the gallery images that show each add-on's panel inside Blender.

ons.naam: paneel met paard en drie stappen
